params.val: based on Steel-type effectiveness vs. the switching-in Pokémon: 0.25x eff. → 4% max HP, 0.5x → 7%, 1x → 13%, 2x → 25%, 4x → 50%

verified via Showdown source (moves.ts gmaxsteelsurge condition, reuses Stealth Rock's damage formula with type forced to Steel): the stored table was missing the 4x row entirely (Ice/Fairy types, e.g. Alolan Ninetales/Vulpix, are weak to Steel-type moves twice over -> 4x -> 50%), and its note incorrectly claimed no 4x case existed. Also fixed 0.25x rounding: 1/32 = 3.125% rounds UP to 4%, not the 3% previously stored (Steel/Electric types like Magnezone resist Steel-type moves twice over -> 0.25x). 'No immunity case' is still correct — nothing is immune to Steel-type moves. Heavy Duty Boots exception was also missing entirely; added as a new fail_if.
